passage:
During PE class, students had to leave their shoes outside the gym. After class, Amy could not find hers. They were white shoes with blue lines.
Everyone helped her look. Finally, they found the shoes near the boys' classroom. A student named Leo was wearing them by mistake.
Leo felt embarrassed. His shoes looked almost the same, but they were one size larger. He had been wondering why his feet hurt during math class.
Amy laughed and said it was fine. The next day, she wrote her name inside her shoes. Leo did the same.
Their teacher said the accident was not serious, but it was useful. Things that look alike still need a way to be told apart.
